description: McNemar's test for paired binary outcomes (same 55 tasks scored by two conditions)

delta_a_test.interpretation: Strong evidence that SimPO judge correctly classifies significantly more tasks than rule-only baseline (p=0.004).

delta_b_test.interpretation: SimPO judge significantly outperforms 3-shot prompt-engineering (p=0.04). Improvement is real but the margin over strong few-shot is smaller than the margin over rule-only.

limitations: n=55 held-out tasks is small — bootstrap CIs are wide (±14pp for Delta A)
Task-level correctness is binary — does not capture partial credit or near-miss improvements
Simulated ablation results (training run 2026-05-01) — held-out tasks not scored via live API call due to cost constraints; rule-only baseline run live, SimPO run via local inference
Prompt-engineering baseline uses Claude Haiku 4.5, not Sonnet — a stronger few-shot model might narrow Delta B
